title: Concept: Next.js development build served
description: A development build serves the compiler output for every route, including the overlay that prints the failing component and the file that defines it. The hot-reload socket it opens also accepts connections from any origin that reaches the host.
applicability: Responses from a Next.js deployment that runs the development server.
risk: The caller reads component paths and source maps, and reaches a hot-reload socket that can be used to inject compiled output.
